resources.string: DarkFi settles transfers privately by default. This wallet shows one DRK balance from your sync endpoint—not separate transparent and shielded totals.\n\nPick servers you trust and keep your recovery phrase backed up.
You might share different receive encodings (deposit string, QR, optional public-style codes). They credit the same DarkFi wallet once sync is connected.\n\nUse whichever format your payer expects.
We keep iterating on faster sync and clearer DarkFi / DRK-focused tooling.\n\nExpect steady improvements.
